title: Skeleton Swordies
description: Makes skeletons and variants spawn with melee weapons!
body:
**Makes skeletons and their variants spawn with melee weapons!**

Skeletons spawn with iron swords, boggeds have stone axes, parcheds dual-wield golden swords, and strays use an iron axe and shield.

Parcheds also have an increased sprinting speed, and strays have improved toughness.
